capabilities: pair a vault with a HitPPT account via a short-lived pairing code
authorize vault-relative folders that HitPPT may browse
send the current note or selected notes to HitPPT from commands or context menus
confirm note transfers before contents leave the vault
extras: Interface is Chinese-only and mobile is not supported; transfers are size-limited (512 KiB per note, 20 notes / 5 MiB per read) and service-side snapshots expire after 48 hours; linked notes and embedded images are not fetched.
problem: Using vault notes as reference material in HitPPT otherwise requires manually copying or uploading them, with no way to browse authorized vault folders from the service.

relations.evidence: Use selected Markdown notes as temporary reference material for presentations in HitPPT.

summary: Connector that sends selected Obsidian notes to HitPPT as temporary 48-hour reference material for AI presentation generation.
